This is a Vite + React + TypeScript advocacy website about the Northshore School District SRO decision.

- Uses Tailwind CSS v4 (with @import "tailwindcss" and @theme)
- Uses Chart.js via react-chartjs-2 for data visualizations
- Uses lucide-react for icons
- Deployed to GitHub Pages with base path `/SRO/`
- The site separates verified facts (sourced to KIRO 7, KOMO, district records) from opinion/analysis (clearly labeled)
